name: interactive-mindmap-editor
description: Create, repair, present, import, and export interactive HTML, Markdown, and XMind mind maps for Codex and Claude workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, present, import, and export HTML/Markdown/XMind mind maps.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex convert text, Markdown, outlines, articles, and notes into editable standalone HTML mind maps, Markdown outlines, or XMind-compatible .xmind files, import Markdown and .xmind files back into plugin JSON, and repair interaction issues such as compact toolbar menus, fullscreen presentation, incremental expand/collapse controls, two-line editing, collapse hit areas, overlap, wrapping, and recursive node operations. The same repository also includes Claude Skill and Claude Code project-memory entry points.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my text into an editable HTML mind map or XMind file, or help me improve an existing interactive mind map editor.
